# Level commands

<!-- ANCHOR: commands -->

## `xrf-cli level albedo`

Report how the base textures of a level's lit surfaces sit as albedo, against the range real materials span

```txt
xrf-cli level albedo [OPTIONS] <--path <path>|--root <root>>
```

| Option                 | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ---------------------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `-p, --path <path>`    |          |         | Path to a compiled level directory, the one holding `level` and `level.geom`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `-r, --root <root>...` |          |         | Root holding an installation's levels. Repeat to layer roots, highest priority first                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `-l, --level <level>`  |          |         | Name of the level to read from the mounted roots, as `levels` knows it                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `--source <source>`    |          | `auto`  | How to read the path: auto treats it as an installation only when it declares one, directory ignores any declaration, volumes mounts every archive volume beneath it, installation requires one, containing-installation searches parent directories for one. Possible values: `auto`, `directory`, `volumes`, `installation`, `containing-installation`. |
| `-s, --silent`         |          |         | Turn off logging                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `-v, --verbose`        |          |         | Turn on verbose logging                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `--json`               |          |         | Write the run's JSON report to stdout, moving human output to stderr                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `--report <PATH>`      |          |         | Write the run's JSON report to a file                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

## `xrf-cli level build`

Build an SDK Level Editor scene's game files into a level directory, as the editor's Build writes them from the scene's
parts: level.game, level.env_mod, level.fog_vol, and level.spawn, level_rs.spawn, level.ps_static, level.snd_static,
level.snd_env and level.wallmarks where the scene holds them; and given the objects roots and game materials, the
build.prj xrLC compiles the geometry and lighting from, level.ltx, level.hom and level.som where objects occlude,
build.details and its atlas build_details.dds where the scene holds details, and the impostor atlas level_lods.dds and
level_lods_nm.dds where a multi-use object has an impostor, and each breakable part as meshes/brkbl#<n>.ogf

```txt
xrf-cli level build [OPTIONS] --path <path> --dest <dest>
```

| Option                              | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ----------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `-p, --path <path>`                 | yes      |         | Path to the scene's .level; its parts are read from the directory beside it named after it                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `-d, --dest <dest>`                 | yes      |         | Path of the level directory to write the files into                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `--objects <objects>...`            |          |         | Objects root ($objects$) the scene's objects are read from, repeatable, each object from the first root holding it; with --game-materials, the build writes build.prj, level.ltx and the occluders                                                                       |
| `--textures <textures>`             |          |         | Textures root ($game_textures$) the detail objects' textures are merged from into build_details.dds, and the multi-use objects' impostor strips (lod/lod_&lt;object&gt;.dds and _nm) into level_lods.dds and level_lods_nm.dds; a scene of details or impostors needs it |
| `--game-materials <game-materials>` |          |         | Game material library, gamemtl.xr, the objects' surfaces name their game materials from                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `--proof-lighting`                  |          |         | Light build.prj at proof quality whatever the scene sets, 3 lightmap pixels a metre, 1 jitter sample, sky and sun at quality 1, to check a level with xrLC in minutes rather than hours; not for a level to ship                                                         |
| `--sdk-impostor-atlas`              |          |         | Keep the impostor atlas within SDK 0.7's 2048 by 2048, refusing a level of more than 128 impostors as that Level Editor does; by default it grows to 4096 a side, as Anomaly's largest levels ship it                                                                    |
| `-f, --force`                       |          |         | Overwrite the files the build writes where the directory already holds them                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `-s, --silent`                      |          |         | Turn off logging                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `-v, --verbose`                     |          |         | Turn on verbose logging                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `--json`                            |          |         | Write the run's JSON report to stdout, moving human output to stderr                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `--report <PATH>`                   |          |         | Write the run's JSON report to a file                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

## `xrf-cli level compile`

Compile a level directory level build wrote into what the game loads, step by step: geometry (the level, its geometry,
collision and lightmaps; the SDK's xrLC), details (level.details lit; xrDO_Light) and ai (level.ai; xrAI -f). Every
step's inputs and every texture build.prj names are checked before any step runs. The compilers run in a working
directory under an fsgame.ltx written for them, never in a game installation

```txt
xrf-cli level compile [OPTIONS] --path <path> --sdk <sdk>
```

| Option                  | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                           |
| ----------------------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `-p, --path <path>`     | yes      |         | Path to the level's directory, &lt;levels&gt;/&lt;level&gt;, holding build.prj and the rest level build wrote                                                         |
| `--steps <steps>`       |          |         | Steps to run, in their order whatever the order given; every step by default. Possible values: `geometry`, `details`, `ai`. Accepts multiple values separated by `,`. |
| `--sdk <sdk>`           | yes      |         | The SDK's editors directory, whose bin holds xrLC, xrDO_Light and xrAI                                                                                                |
| `--gamedata <gamedata>` |          |         | Game data the compilers read gamemtl.xr and shaders_xrlc.xr from; the gamedata holding the level's levels directory by default                                        |
| `--textures <textures>` |          |         | Textures root with a .thm for every texture build.prj names; the game data's textures by default                                                                      |
| `--work <work>`         |          |         | Directory the compilers run in, with their fsgame.ltx and logs; one in the system's temporary directory                                                               |
| `-s, --silent`          |          |         | Turn off logging                                                                                                                                                      |
| `-v, --verbose`         |          |         | Turn on verbose logging                                                                                                                                               |
| `--json`                |          |         | Write the run's JSON report to stdout, moving human output to stderr                                                                                                  |
| `--report <PATH>`       |          |         | Write the run's JSON report to a file                                                                                                                                 |

## `xrf-cli level decompile`

Decompile a compiled level's directory into an SDK Level Editor scene (.level and its parts), with a .level.xrf.json
provenance sidecar beside it. The scene holds the parts the build passes through (particles, sounds, sound environments,
fog volumes, wall marks, patrol paths, respawn points, environment modifiers and entity spawns), the level's glows and
lights, and its static geometry as one .object per sector with the sectors and portals

```txt
xrf-cli level decompile [OPTIONS] --path <path> --dest <dest>
```

| Option                                  | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| --------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `-p, --path <path>`                     | yes      |         | Path to the level's directory, holding level, build.lights, level.game, level.ps_static and the rest                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `-d, --dest <dest>`                     | yes      |         | Path of the .level to write; its parts go in the directory beside it named after it, its sidecar beside it, and its name is the level's                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `--objects <objects>`                   |          |         | Objects root ($objects$) the scene's .object files are written under, at levels/&lt;level&gt;/; by default the objects directory beside the destination's directory, as the SDK lays out rawdata/levels and rawdata/objects                                                                                         |
| `--textures <textures>`                 |          |         | Game textures root ($game_textures$) the textures the objects need for the build, such as the tree models' impostor strips under lod/, are written under; by default gamedata/textures beside the destination's rawdata directory, as the SDK lays out editors/rawdata and editors/gamedata                         |
| `--surfaces <surfaces>`                 |          | `infer` | How the geometry's surfaces are dressed: infer each game material from the collision face beneath and a compiler shader fitting what the level shows, or give every surface the editor's defaults. Possible values: `infer`, `defaults`.                                                                            |
| `--game-materials <game-materials>`     |          |         | Game material library naming the collision materials; gamemtl.xr in the level's gamedata by default                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `--compiler-shaders <compiler-shaders>` |          |         | Compiler shader library inferred compiler shaders are chosen from; shaders_xrlc.xr in the level's gamedata by default                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `--library <library>...`                |          |         | Object library root, such as an SDK's rawdata/objects: its objects found placed in the static geometry and its trees found as tree models are placed by reference and copied beside the objects, and its surfaces' pairings of engine and compiler shaders break ties between compiler shaders that fit; repeatable |
| `--spawn <spawn>`                       |          |         | Root spawn whose objects on the level replace level.spawn's entities, read from spawns/&lt;spawn&gt;.spawn beside the level's levels directory; all.spawn by default where it exists                                                                                                                                |
| `-f, --force`                           |          |         | Overwrite an existing .level, its parts, its sidecar and its objects                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `-s, --silent`                          |          |         | Turn off logging                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `-v, --verbose`                         |          |         | Turn on verbose logging                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `--json`                                |          |         | Write the run's JSON report to stdout, moving human output to stderr                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `--report <PATH>`                       |          |         | Write the run's JSON report to a file                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
